title: Show a podium of the best three scores
pr_body: Adds `podium()` for the results page; ties share a rank.

bugs.title: Numbers sorted as strings
bugs.rationale: Array.prototype.sort without a comparator sorts by string value, so [9, 10, 100] becomes [10, 100, 9] and reverse() puts 9 first: the podium shows the wrong players once scores have different digit counts.

traps.rationale: Explicit undefined check handles a 0 score correctly.

author: claude
